story: Tom is a new boy in the class.
Anna is a girl. She says, Hello!
Tom says, Hi! My name is Tom.
Anna says, I am Anna. You are my friend.
The teacher says, Hello, Tom and Anna!
Tom is happy. Anna is happy.
chant: Hello, hello, what is your name?
Hello, hello, I am Tom.
Hello, hello, are you a boy?
Hello, hello, are you a girl?
Hello, hello, you are my friend.
Hello, hello, hello again!

story: Kim is in class.
The teacher says, Look at the alphabet.
Kim sees a letter. She sees a word.
Kim can spell her name.
She can write her name on the board.
The teacher says, Well done, Kim!
chant: Letters, letters, in the alphabet.
Say the letters with me.
Spell a word, spell a name.
Write the letters, write the words.
Letters, letters, in the alphabet.
Well done, well done, you can spell!

story: Ben has some things on the table.
He has one book and two pens.
He has three balls and four apples.
Ben can count the things.
Anna says, I can count too!
They count to ten. Ten is a big number!
chant: One, two, three, four, five.
Six, seven, eight, nine, ten.
Count the apples, count the balls.
One, two, three, four, five.
Six, seven, eight, nine, ten.
Number, number, count again!

story: Lucy is in the garden.
She sees eleven flowers and twelve birds.
Lucy says, How many fish are in the water?
She counts the fish. There are fifteen fish!
Sam counts his balls. There are twenty balls!
Lucy and Sam can count to twenty. Hooray!
chant: Eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen.
Fifteen, sixteen, seventeen, eighteen.
Nineteen, twenty, count with me.
How many fish? Fifteen fish!
Eleven, twelve, thirteen, fourteen.
Number twenty, hooray!

story: Grace has a box of crayons.
She has a red crayon and a blue crayon.
She draws a green tree.
She draws a yellow sun.
Tom says, I like the colours!
Grace is happy. It is a nice picture.
chant: Red, red, I can see red.
Blue, blue, I can see blue.
Green, green, I can see green.
Yellow, yellow, I can see yellow.
Colours, colours, I like colours.
Red, blue, green, yellow!

story: This is Sam. Sam has a big family.
Sam has a mum and a dad.
Sam has a brother and a baby sister.
Sam has a grandma and a grandpa.
They are at home. They smile.
chant: Mum, mum, I love my mum.
Dad, dad, I love my dad.
Sister, brother, baby too.
Grandma, grandpa, I love you.
My family, my family, I love my family.

story: Tom is in the park.
He can run with his legs.
He can kick the ball with his foot.
He can wave with his hand and his arm.
He can jump with his feet.
He puts his hands on his head.
chant: Head, head, this is my head.
Arm, arm, this is my arm.
Hand, hand, clap your hands.
Leg, leg, foot, foot, these are my feet.
This is my body, I like my body.

story: Lucy looks in the mirror.
She sees her face.
She has two eyes, two ears and a small nose.
She has long hair and a big smile.
She smiles with her mouth. Lucy is happy.
chant: Eyes, eyes, I see with my eyes.
Ears, ears, I listen with my ears.
Nose, nose, mouth, mouth, smile, smile.
Hair, hair, this is my hair.
This is my face, my happy face.

story: It is a nice day. Mum has a long skirt.
Grace has a red dress and white shoes.
Ben has blue jeans and a yellow shirt.
Ben has a hat. Grace has a jacket.
They like their clothes. They go to the park.
chant: Hat, hat, a red hat.
Shirt, shirt, a blue shirt.
Dress, dress, a pink dress.
Skirt and jacket, shoes and jeans.
Nice clothes, nice clothes, I like my clothes.

story: Kim is in the classroom.
She has a bag. She has a book in it.
She has a pen and a pencil.
Kim sits on a chair at her desk.
The teacher says, Look at the board.
chant: Book, book, open your book.
Pen, pen, pencil, pencil.
Desk, desk, chair, chair.
Board, board, bag, bag.
I like my classroom, I like my classroom.
commands: Put your pen on your desk.

story: Miss Sue is the teacher in the classroom.
She says, Listen, class.
Tom and Anna look at the board.
Anna opens her book. Tom opens his book.
Miss Sue says, Close your book, please. Stand up, class.
Tom and Anna stand up. They sit on chairs.
chant: Open, open, open the book.
Close, close, close the book.
Look, look, look at me.
Listen, listen, one, two, three.
Stand up, stand up, sit on a chair.
Open, close, look and listen.

story: Ben has a red car and a robot.
Lucy has a doll and a teddy.
Sam has a big kite.
They play a game with a ball.
They love their toys. It is a fun day.
chant: I have a ball, a big red ball.
I have a doll, a small doll.
I have a teddy, a small teddy.
I have a robot, a funny robot.
I have a kite, a blue kite.
I have a car, a red car.
Toys, toys, I love my toys.

story: Kim has a pet cat.
The cat is small and sweet.
Kim gives milk to the cat.
Tom has a pet bird.
The bird can sing. The fish can swim.
Sam has a pet mouse. It is very small.
chant: I have a pet, a pet, a pet.
A cat, a cat, my sweet cat.
A bird, a bird, my blue bird.
A fish, a fish, my small fish.
A mouse, a mouse, my small mouse.
I love my pet.

story: Sam and Grace go to the zoo.
They see a big elephant.
The giraffe is very big and the monkey can jump.
Then they see a zebra. It is black and white.
They love the zoo.
chant: Elephant, elephant, big and grey.
Giraffe, giraffe, big, big, big.
Monkey, monkey, jump, jump, jump.
Zebra, zebra, black and white.
Zoo, zoo, I love the zoo.

story: Tom has a bag of fruit.
There is an apple and a banana in the bag.
There is an orange and a mango too.
Tom gives an apple to Eva.
Eva likes grapes. Tom likes pears.
Then they eat the fruit.
chant: Apple, apple, red and sweet.
Banana, banana, yellow and long.
Orange, orange, big and nice.
Mango, mango, big and nice.
Pear, pear, green and sweet.
Grapes, grapes, I like grapes.
Fruit, fruit, I like fruit.

story: It is breakfast. Sam is in the kitchen.
Sam has bread, an egg and some milk.
Anna says, Can I have some juice?
Sam gives Anna the juice and an apple.
They eat and drink. They smile.
chant: Bread, bread, I like bread.
Milk, milk, I like milk.
Eggs, eggs, I like eggs.
Eat, eat, eat with me.
Bread, milk and juice for me!

story: Grace has a new house.
There is a big kitchen.
There is a table and four chairs.
Grace is in her bedroom.
There is a bed and a blue lamp.
She opens the door and says, I love my home!
chant: Door, door, open the door.
Bed, bed, in my bedroom.
Table, chair, in the kitchen.
Lamp, lamp, a blue lamp.
I love my home, my home!

story: Tom is in the garden.
The sun is big and yellow.
There is a bird in the tree.
A bee is on a red flower.
Tom plays with his ball.
He is very happy.
chant: Sun, sun, big and yellow.
Tree, tree, big and green.
Bird, bird, in the tree.
Flower, flower, red and pink.
Bee, bee, on the flower.

story: Ben and Lucy are at the park.
Ben kicks the football.
Lucy runs and catches the ball.
Lucy throws the ball to Ben.
Ben can jump. Lucy can swim.
They play and have fun.
chant: Run, run, run with me.
Jump, jump, jump with me.
Kick the ball, one, two, three.
Catch the ball, throw the ball.
Swim, swim, swim with me.

story: Kim and Dad are at the bus stop.
She sees a red bus and a blue bike.
She sees a car, too.
The bus stops. Kim and Dad get on the bus.
Kim sees a plane, a train and a boat.
She likes the bus.
chant: Bus, bus, a big red bus.
Car, car, a small blue car.
Bike, bike, go, go, go.
Train, train, boat and plane.
Look at the street with me!

story: On Monday, Tom goes to school with Anna.
On Wednesday, they play football in the park.
On Friday, Anna says, What's your favourite month?
Tom says, February! I have a birthday in February.
On Sunday, Tom has a birthday cake.
There are seven days in a week. Tom is happy!
chant: Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, too,
Thursday, Friday, me and you!
Saturday, Sunday, clap and say!
Seven days in a week, hooray!
January, February, March, April, May,
June, July, August, come and play!
September, October, November, too,
December! Twelve months for me and you!
commands: Say the days of the week.
Say the month of your birthday.
Count the days in a week.

story: Kim has a bag for lunch.
In the bag, there is an apple and an egg.
Kim gives Ben an orange.
Ben gives Kim a banana.
Kim says, Thank you! I have a banana now.
Ben says, Thank you! I have an orange now.
chant: A cat, a book, a ball, a hat,
An apple, an egg, I like that!
A banana, a lemon, one, two, three,
An orange, an ice cream, for you and me!
A cat, a book, an apple, an egg!

story: Lucy writes a sentence on the board.
Her sentence starts with a capital letter.
Her sentence ends with a full stop.
Tom and Lucy are names. Names have capital letters.
The word I has a capital letter, too.
The teacher says, Well done, Lucy!
chant: Big letter, big letter, at the start!
Full stop, full stop, at the end!
Tom, Anna, Sam and I,
Names and I have capital letters, my friend!
Big letter, start! Full stop, end!
commands: Write your name with a capital letter.
Show me a capital letter for Anna.

story: Sam and Grace have lunch in the kitchen.
Sam eats soup with a spoon.
Grace eats rice and chicken.
Sam drinks water from a glass.
Grace drinks milk from a cup.
They say, Thank you, Mum! Lunch is great!
chant: Eat, eat, eat your soup,
Eat your soup with a spoon!
Drink, drink, drink your milk,
Drink your juice from a cup!
Water in a glass, drink, drink, drink!
Soup with a spoon, eat, eat, eat!
commands: Show me how you eat soup.
Show me how you drink juice.
Say I eat with a spoon.
Say I drink milk from a glass.

story: There is a big clock on the kitchen wall.
Ben looks at the clock. He can play now!
Ben plays football for one hour.
Then he reads a book for fifteen minutes.
Grace paints for fifty minutes. She paints five flowers.
Ben and Grace are happy. Well done!
chant: Five, fifteen, fifty, say them with me!
Five, fifteen, fifty, one, two, three!
A clock on the wall, a clock on the wall,
One hour, one hour, play with a ball!
Fifteen minutes, fifty minutes, too,
One hour of fun for me and you!

story: Tom has a ball. The ball is red.
Anna has a kite. The kite is blue.
Sam has a cat. The cat is small.
The cat sits in a box.
The box is big. The cat is happy.
chant: I have a ball. The ball is red.
I have a kite. The kite is blue.
I have a cat. The cat is small.
I have a box. The box is new!

story: Kim goes to school at eight o'clock.
On Monday, she has an English lesson.
On Friday, she plays tennis at four o'clock.
Her birthday is in May.
In December, she goes to the beach with her family.
Kim is happy on Sunday, at home with Grandma.
chant: At eight o'clock, at eight o'clock,
On Monday, on Friday, on Sunday, too!
In May, in June, in July, hooray!
At for the clock, on for the day,
In for the month, let's say it, hooray!

story: Lucy can swim in the sea.
Her brother Ben can jump.
Grandpa can ride a bike.
The bird can fly. The fish can swim.
Lucy says, I can sing! Listen!
Lucy, Ben and Grandpa are happy at the beach.
chant: Anna can swim, Anna can swim,
He can jump, he can jump,
I can run, I can run,
Birds can fly, birds can fly,
We can sing, we can sing!
commands: Say my friend can ride a bike.

story: I am Alex. I am happy today.
This is my sister, Eva. She is seven.
This is my brother, Nick. He is ten.
We are in the park with my family.
Nick is sad. His kite is in a tree.
Dad gets the kite. Nick is happy. We are happy!
chant: I am happy, I am happy,
He is happy, she is happy,
We are happy, you are happy,
You are my friend, you are my friend!
I am, he is, she is, they are!
